node.title: Time::Piece, localtime -- ambiguous, parentheses
node.author: leszekdubiel
node.doctext: Please tell why parenthesis make a differense here: # perl -e 'use Time::Piece; $x = localtime; $y = localtime() - $x; print "$y\n"; ' 0 # perl -e 'use Time::Piece; $x = localtime; $y = (localtime) - $x; print "$y\n"; ' 0 # perl -e 'use Time::Piece; $x = localtime; $y = localtime - $x; print "$y\n"; ' Thu Jan 1 01:00:00 1970
